items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: There's a lot of numbers I played with Bunk Johnson.

ctx.x: I got the orchestration from that. Yeah. The old Robichaux band, Maurice Duran had some of Robichaux's music and he sold me a bunch of it all years ago.

Yeah, well, I remember them two old numbers good when he used to play. I was a small kid, but I remember them good. Them the two numbers even that form. No, I don't remember the others. But for the other band, I tell you, there's a lot of numbers they played. You're trying to get your work finished up. And I can't recall the NAMM back from way back. There's a lot of numbers I played with Bunk Johnson. And they were so old back. He know them all. Oh, yeah, he knew them. And right now, if he's sitting down playing,…
You said Blue Bell's Goodbye was one I believe.
